scope: One isolated synthetic Codec microprofile, 100k events and32 deterministic 512x512 float64 arrays per mode. Profiles hash-only and Full Capture separately, then strictly compares the complete logical streams. No Adapter, planner, S07, witness, H&E or outer experimental acceptance call.
comparison: Codec strict byte-equivalent logical stream and complete business process; separate cProfile outputs for B and C.
limitations: Direct Codec microprofile isolates storage path but does not validate Adapter or real S07.
No server deployment or run is authorized by this proposal.
